_comment: This file is the single source of truth for the dictionary feature in the
MVP. It is read at build time by lib/vocabulary.ts and compiled into a
lookup Map, so a translation costs no network request and no database
Each entry carries a `forms` array listing the inflections that should
resolve to it (plurals, -ed/-ing, nominalisations, British spellings).
Passage text says 'scrutinized', not 'scrutinize', so matching on the
headword alone would miss most real occurrences.
To grow the dictionary: add entries here. To move it into Postgres later,
the `Vocabulary` model in prisma/schema.prisma mirrors this shape — seed it

entries.explanation: Present everywhere at once; seemingly found in every place.
entries.explanationUz: Bir vaqtning o'zida hamma joyda uchraydigan; juda keng tarqalgan.
entries.example: Smartphones have become ubiquitous in modern classrooms.

entries.explanation: Having mixed or contradictory feelings about something.
entries.explanationUz: Biror narsaga nisbatan bir vaqtda ham ijobiy, ham salbiy his tuyadigan; qat'iy qarorga kelolmagan.
entries.example: She felt ambivalent about leaving her hometown for university.

entries.explanation: Showing great attention to detail; very careful and precise.
entries.explanationUz: Mayda tafsilotlarga ham katta e'tibor beradigan; juda ehtiyotkor va aniq.
entries.example: The researcher kept meticulous records of every measurement.

entries.explanation: Dealing with things practically rather than theoretically.
entries.explanationUz: Nazariyaga emas, amaliy natijaga tayanadigan; hayotiy yondashuvli.
entries.example: They took a pragmatic approach and fixed the cheapest problems first.

entries.explanation: Requiring great effort; difficult and tiring.
entries.explanationUz: Katta kuch talab qiladigan; qiyin va charchatadigan.
entries.example: Preparing for the exam was an arduous but rewarding process.

entries.explanation: Honest and direct, even when the truth is uncomfortable.
entries.explanationUz: Halol va to'g'ridan-to'g'ri gapiradigan; haqiqatni yashirmaydigan.
entries.example: In a candid interview, the author admitted that her first draft had failed.

entries.explanation: To examine something closely and critically.
entries.explanationUz: Biror narsani diqqat bilan, tanqidiy ko'z bilan tekshirmoq.
entries.example: Editors scrutinize every claim before publication.

entries.explanation: Very weak or slight; lacking a solid basis.
entries.explanationUz: Juda kuchsiz yoki asossiz; mustahkam poydevorga ega bo'lmagan.
entries.example: The link between the two events is tenuous at best.

entries.explanation: Able to recover quickly from difficulty or damage.
entries.explanationUz: Qiyinchilikdan keyin tez o'ziga keladigan; chidamli.
entries.example: Coral reefs are less resilient to heat than scientists once believed.

entries.explanation: A fundamental model or typical example of how something works.
entries.explanationUz: Biror sohada qabul qilingan asosiy model yoki namuna.
entries.example: The discovery overturned the dominant paradigm in genetics.

entries.explanation: Based on observation or experiment rather than on theory.
entries.explanationUz: Nazariya emas, kuzatuv va tajriba natijalariga asoslangan.
entries.example: There is little empirical evidence for the claim.

entries.explanation: A very small difference in meaning, feeling, or tone.
entries.explanationUz: Ma'no, ohang yoki hissiyotdagi juda kichik, nozik farq.
entries.example: A good translation preserves the nuance of the original.
